classification_definition.order_conditional_instability: canonical unit has exactly one of demonstration orders exact; reported separately to avoid double-counting record-level failures.
classification_definition.valid_count_construction: 3x3 grid, only the query color, and a left-aligned nonzero prefix on row 1; prefix length is the predicted component count.

mechanism_selection.selection_rationale: wrong component counts with otherwise valid Count construction predominate over construction-only errors
mechanism_selection.selection_rule: Director response: wrong-count-valid-construction -> object-centric; correct-count-wrong-construction -> output construction; order instability dominates -> rule-grounding/order robustness.
